title: Map pids-limit 0 to unlimited for runc
body:
Docker documents HostConfig.PidsLimit 0 as unlimited, but runc sets pids.max=1 for OCI pids.limit 0. Normalize 0 to -1 when building the OCI spec so native CLI, compat API, and kube play behave consistently.

Fixes: https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29826
